goal.scope: First substantial edition, not an exhaustive charity ranking or a promise of independently verified impact.

countingRule: Included entries must correspond one-to-one to the assessment dataset. Queued leads, deferred or excluded candidates do not count. Counts describe this source snapshot; deployment must be verified separately.
evidencePolicy: Primary-source mechanism review and preliminary editorial scoring only. Independent human and affected-community reviews of this tracker’s editorial scores are pending unless a scoped future audit explicitly records otherwise; this does not negate separately attributed external program evaluations. Unverified identity, repository licenses and checklist adoption cannot be inferred from a candidate name.

progressChecklist.requirement: Durable included/candidate ledger with decisions, gaps and references.
At least 200 distinct source-backed assessments, without duplicate parent/project counting.
Inspect named project licenses and maintainer/steward/sponsor roles for new and appropriate existing profiles.
Seek defensible source mappings without forced alignment or implied adoption.
Keep v0.2 weights 35/25/15/15/5/5, older review dates, legacy lenses, uncertainty and unscored registry intact.
Tests, profile/count/source checks, unique cards, exact live release checks, focused filters and expanded funder selections.
Audit all goal requirements against current production, clean up resources and deliver coverage/limitations report.
